info.title: DW Alliance website editor
info.description: Edit a DW Alliance website for the signed-in person. Every website file (HTML pages, CSS, JavaScript, images) is a file. Changes are made as drafts with a preview link; nothing goes live until publishDraft is called, which the assistant only does when the person says so. Every change keeps version history. Links inside pages should be relative (for example about.html or images/logo.png). Affiliate program actions (getMyAffiliate ... approveAffiliateTransfer) work on the connected website's affiliate program; referral codes and links only go to the affiliate's email, and prices or plans cannot be changed.
